verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK documents subagents as separate agent instances the main agent spawns for focused subtasks, with isolated context, parallel runs and specialized instructions. They can be defined programmatically via the `agents` parameter in `query()` options, so multi-agent orchestration inside one workflow is a first-party capability. Related Claude Code docs describe per-subagent context, prompts, tools and permissions, plus agent teams with a lead session. missing for 10: evidence that peer-to-peer handoffs or crew/team coordination are exposed specifically through the SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration of subagent orchestration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: Subagents are separate agent instances that your main agent can spawn to handle focused subtasks. Use them to isolate context, run multiple analyses in parallel, and apply specialized instructions
Programmatically: use the `agents` parameter in your `query()` options.
Each subagent runs in its own context window with a custom system prompt, specific tool access, and independent permissions.
Agent teams let you coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together. One session acts as the team lead, coordinating work, assigning tasks, and synthesizing results.
